newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet fuel trundles higher with gas oil futures.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet fuel trundles higher with gas oil futures.

text.p: European jet fuel prices trundled higher on Thursday on the back of stronger IPE gas oil futures, traders said, but activity remained muted.
April IPE gas oil was trading $1.25 a tonne higher at $168.75 at 1701 GMT.

Plentiful supplies of jet in the barge market may impact premiums, but so far these have remained broadly unchanged around April IPE gas oil +$20 fob ARA. Cargoes in NWE were pegged around April IPE +$23 cif.
In the Mediterranean, jet was seen to have eased slightly with fob premiums down to about April IPE gas oil +$7
